_comment: Country (ISO-3166 alpha-2) -> defaults. 'method' picks the calculation convention used by that country's OWN prayer-time authority; 'madhhab' picks the school, which sets BOTH the Asr shadow factor and the rule matrix. Both are only DEFAULTS - the user can override either in settings, an explicit choice is persisted and always wins, and where we hold an authority's extracted timetable the app defaults to that (the AUTHORITY option) instead. Evidence for each country's authority + method: research/prayer-time-authorities.md (verified 2026-07-19). Coverage: research/prayer-time-coverage.md (generated).
_methodComment: Each value is the calculation convention that country's official authority uses, so computing with it reproduces the authority's own times where the authority simply defines its times by a method (the majority of the world). Only a minority publish tables that DEVIATE from a pure preset (ihtiyat margins, observational tweaks); those are listed in research section 8 and are served exactly only once their tables are extracted (LK/ACJU done). Every value must be a key that exists in METHODS (astronomy.js); an unknown key silently falls back to MuslimWorldLeague. Countries not listed default to MuslimWorldLeague, the most widely-adopted convention.
_predominantComment: The school actually predominant in each country. NOT used to select a ruleset - the app defaults everyone to the evidence-based ruling. Kept only so research/prayer-time-coverage.md can note, per country, which madhhab a user there might expect. maliki/hanbali/jafari/ibadi matrices do not ship.
